use_case_summary: Primary: real-time agent assist (smart suggestions, rapid triage) with strict latency SLOs; secondary: automated ticket summarization and action invocation (tool-calls) to reduce AHT. Must operate reliably under short lived spikes (x6 baseline). Require routing to cheaper model variants when capacity constrained, plus provable fallbacks to prevent agent wait. Key metrics: 99th pct latency <250ms for agent assist, sustained throughput 200 concurrent agents, burst capacity to 1200 for <2 hour windows.
technical_requirements: Zendesk native app + backend hook for tool-calls; OAuth2/SAML SSO for agents; audit logs forwarded to SIEM; KMS integration for key management; data residency policy: EU + US segmentation; ability to run Private control plane in VPC or on-prem pre-approved stack; need observability: token-level cost + 99p latency dashboards and per-route traces.
